Name: Rocky coastal landscape
Interpretation: Coastal and relief-influenced areas where steep/fracture-valley relief and coastal signals coincide.

Name: Sandy coastal landscape
Interpretation: Sandy and coastal areas, mainly where the aeolian sand and sandy coast factor is strong.

Name: Agricultural fracture-valley landscape
Interpretation: Open agricultural landscape with a clear fracture-valley or low-hill structure.

Name: Forested fracture-valley landscape
Interpretation: Forested fracture-valley and nature areas with a strong forest/protected-nature factor.

Name: Plain and agricultural landscape
Interpretation: Larger open, low-lying and agriculture-dominated landscape rooms.
